page_title: PAL 1-3 RSO | Las Palmas v Real Sociedad 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
90+1' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
90+1' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Alex Remiro. Las Palmas have a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Real Sociedad players look gutted.
88' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Real Sociedad players aren’t happy.
88' The ball hits the back of the net and Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is the one who put it there!
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) is replacing Jon Ander Olasagasti.
80' Diego Martinez prepares a substitution. Alberto Moleiro is replaced by Marc Cardona (Las Palmas).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) comes onto the pitch for Javier Munoz.
79' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
78' Great save! Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Dinko Horkas.
76' The referee is firm and issues Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) a deserved yellow card.
71' The game has come to an end for Juanma Herzog. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas).
71' Diego Martinez decides to make a substitution. Dario Essugo will be replaced by Jose Campana (Las Palmas).
68' 1 - 3 A nice goal by Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad)! He coolly drilled a low shot deep inside the left post.

67' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Dinko Horkas pulls off a brilliant save.
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sandro Ramirez as he is replaced by Marvin (Las Palmas).
63' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Ander Barrenetxea and he is replaced by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad).
63' That's the end of the game for Mikel Oyarzabal, who is replaced by Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad).
60' 1 - 2 Fabio Silva provides Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.

56' 0 - 2 Goal! Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Ander Barrenetxea inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. 0:2.
55' The current number of shots on goal is 4:4.
47' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends it out of play.

47' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
46' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Aihen Munoz comes on the pitch for Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the bar!
44' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar.
42' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
41' Close! Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
35' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) swings in a cross from the corner, but Alex Remiro reads it well and gathers the ball.

35' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The ball goes out of play. Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.

34' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Las Palmas.
32' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

32' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
28' A dangerous looking corner kick from Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is cleared to safety by the defence.
28' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play and Las Palmas manage to earn a corner.
24' Igor Zubeldia is substituted due to injury. Imanol Alguacil gives a chance to Jon Martin (Real Sociedad).
22' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
18' The linesman raises his flag. Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) is adjudged offside.
12' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Alex Remiro makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
9' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
4' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
3' The corner is flicked onto Fabio Silva (Las Palmas), but his close-range header flies just over the bar.
3' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Las Palmas will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' The first half has just begun.
Real Sociedad will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Miguel Ortiz.
